tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las byung ba'i gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo 'jam dpal dbyangs// dbyer med bla ma dam par gus btud nas// gang de'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal go bde ba// dang po'i las can don du bshad kyis nyon// de la 'dir 'jam dpal rdo rje lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// rang skad cig gis 'jam dpal rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs ka'i mām̐ yig ser po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo mañdzu shrī badz+ra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig

oṃ shu n+ya tā dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las kun bzang yab yum gyi ngo bo chos 'byung gi nang du rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad+ma rgyas pa dang*/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du mam̐ las ral gri mam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal rdo rje sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ser po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar po/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri dang mda'/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum 'jam dpal rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug ma sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra bas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la gnas shing sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i gnas su zla ba'i gdan la mig tu k+ṣiṃ las sa snying dkar po/ rna bar dzīṃ las phyag rdor sngon po/ snar bam̐ las nam snying ser po/ lcer lam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po/ lus skam̐ las sgrib sel ljang gu/ yid sam̐ las kun bzang sngon po/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sngon po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ral gri ser po mām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar 'dus mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ ye shes pa dang thugs rdo rje gnyis ka rang gi snying ga'i thugs rdo rje la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin du gyur/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje'i āḥlas gsung rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar tshur 'dus mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ ye shes pa dang gsung rdo rje gnyis ka rang gi snying ga'i gsung rdo rje la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāk+ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang spyi bo'i sku rdo rje'i oṃ las sku rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa dpag tu med pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ ye shes pa dang sku rdo rje gnyis ka spyi bo'i sku rdo rje la thim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ yang rang gi snying ga'i mam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mām̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ mañdzu shrī badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rang gi thugs kar mam̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad rgyas par gyur/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'jam dpal rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas chos 'byung gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid thugs ka'i mam̐ la thim/ de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ de'i ngang las rang nyid 'jam dpal rdo rje'i skur gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dpal rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon rgyas par bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma dbul bar 'dod na/ gtor ma zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba chu chang gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ mañdzu shrī badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhāñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// sogs kyi mthar/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gi bar/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/

rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// ༈ /'jam pa'i rdo rje sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// dpal bde ba dang bi ma la gup+ta// rin chen rnam gnyis ri sul rnal 'byor ma// gnyan lo chos rgyan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gong ma lnga dang dam pa kun dga' grags// bkra shis dpal dang kun dga' bsod nams zhabs// rdo dpal kīrti shrī gangs pa dang*// sa bzang khu dbon rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngor chen mus chen rgyal tshab kun mkhyen rje// rat+na war+dha dkon mchog lhun grub dang*// sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang po// mchog legs khu dbon rnams la= /sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// 'gro ba'i bla ma mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// gdams pa'i bka' babs rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin rnams la= /de ltar gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhar// nges par shes nas lus rten 'di nyid la// 'ja' lus mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes 'jam rdor mngon rtogs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa 'di'ang dge slong tshul khrims rgya mtsho lags kyi nyams bzhes su bya bral bas bkra shis pa'i chos sder sug bris su btab pa'o// ༈ /brgyud 'debs kha skong ni/ sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang po// dpal ldan don grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sher 'byung ye shes bzang po bud+dha'i zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub mkhan chen maṅga la// sangs rgyas ye shes kun blo nam mkha'i mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gus pas sogs sbrel lo// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang sgrub par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par mchod stegs ji ltar 'tshams pa'i steng du mañdzi'i khar maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le byas te 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu gcig dgod/

mdun du gtor zlum/ de'i mthar dbang ldan gyi gnas su mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar du mchod yon sogs g.yas skor du bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog slob ma la bkye rgyu'i nas sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len ltar sta gon bya'o// dngos gzhi ngag 'don la/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ zhes pas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ mthar rol mo dkrol te/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// de nas bdag bskyed ni/ brgyud 'debs sngon 'gros bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i skur gyur/ ces bsdu ldang gi bar gong bzhin dang*/ de nas mdun gyi tshom bur dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las kun bzang yab yum gyi sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong ltar la/ rang nyid la de nyid dang*/ rang gi la de'i zhes par bsgyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin brlabs nas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī badz+ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis mchod bstod bya/

gtor ma chu chang gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ mañdzu shrī badz+ra sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// sogs kyi mthar/ 'jam dpal rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ 'das gtor gyi lhag ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas mgron dgug nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ ting shag brdung*/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing gus pa'i sems su mdzod// bdag kyang byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces pas phrin las gzhol/ mtheb srin gyis se gol dang*/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsams la/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ gong ltar bzlas pa ci rigs dang*/ thal mo sbyar la bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs kyis gong ltar gsol ba gdab bo// slob ma rnams bos nas sems bskyed gsal btab la/

da lam 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba 'bul ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi 'os grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob dpon la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyim pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag ni 'gro la phan don du// brtse chen khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// ma lus rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ brgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkha' bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa bzhin mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang la stsal du gsol/ zhes pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la/ sku'i rjes gnang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang*/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i sems kyis mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/

mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gis bsdus pa'i phung po khams dang skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du 'dzin pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos pa byas/ stong pa'i ngang las kun bzang yab yum gyi ngo bo chos 'byung zhes pa nas/ khyed rang rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes bsgyur bas/ sku rdo rje dkar po rnams gsal lam gyis btab nas/ slob dpon la khyed rnams kyis bsgoms pa lta bu'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i yid kyis gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim par mos pa byas/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas kyang 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs med pa'i rnam pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams na mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

rol mo bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥmam̐ hūm̐ gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā we shā ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing gnyis su med par bstim/ de ltar na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku yi rjes su gnang ba thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas sku bsgom pa dang sku'i 'phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar mam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs/ khyed rang rnams 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can du gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i mam̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas te/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces brjod la/ sngags lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos pa byas/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sngags kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig de ltar na bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngag gis skye ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ de la brten nas gsung bzlas pa dang gsung gi phrin las mtha' dag bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gsal ba'i zhal nas/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// bsgom pa'ang dmigs su med pa'o// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don khyed rang rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu de nyid la yid cher gyis gtad pa la brten nas/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i tshul can du ltems kyis zhu ste thugs ka'i sa bon la thim zhing*/ sa bon de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te/ mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du rang yal du yal gyis yal ba la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i mtshan nyid can khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la skyes par mos pa mdzod/ spro na me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig
